products.current_audit: Audit: FAILED. Disqualified from Tiers 1 and 2 due to inclusion of non-GMO expeller-pressed canola oil, non-GMO palm shortening, added cane sugar, and organic barley malt syrup. UPF Evaluation: Uses seed oils and added sugars despite authentic Brooklyn coal-fired marketing.

products.name: Amy's Organic Thin Crust Margherita Pizza
products.current_audit: Audit: FAILED. Disqualified from Tiers 1 and 2 due to expeller-pressed high oleic safflower and/or sunflower oil, organic honey, and organic cane sugar. UPF Evaluation: Marketing relies on organic halos while incorporating inflammatory seed oils and refined sweeteners into a savory base.

products.name: Quest Thin Crust 4-Cheese Pizza
products.current_audit: Audit: FAILED. Disqualified due to vegetable oil (canola and/or sunflower oil). UPF Evaluation: Highly engineered ultra-processed food matrix relying on milk protein isolate, whey protein isolate, soluble corn fiber, cellulose, and xanthan gum to achieve artificial macronutrient targets.
